proposal.summary: A flaw in openstack-glance allows a remote, authenticated attacker to tamper with images, compromising the integrity of virtual machines created from those images.
proposal.cwe_quote: A flaw was found in openstack-glance. This issue could allow a remote, authenticated attacker to tamper with images, compromising the integrity of virtual machines created using these modified images.
